prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1155; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with a distal radius fracture sustained when the arm was braced against the vehicle interior. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported crash forces and the fracture pattern seen on imaging. Radiographs clearly confirm the fracture, and physical examination findings, including localized tenderness, swelling, and restricted wrist motion, are in agreement with those images. There is no record of prior injury or treatment to this wrist or forearm.

Care was delivered over 29 visits and followed a typical course for this injury: initial immobilization and pain management, followed by serial imaging to confirm alignment and healing, then a progressive therapy program to restore grip strength and range of motion. Visit frequency decreased steadily as function improved and pain resolved. Billing records reflect the scheduled treatment with no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services.

At discharge the patient has near-full range of motion, improved grip strength, and is returning to daily activities. Ongoing home exercises and a follow-up review have been recommended.
